semiconductor_relevance: High — Aomei (Zhengzhou) Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. specializes in high-precision equipment for semiconductor processing, particularly in grinding and polishing applications.
summary: Aomei (Zhengzhou) Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and maintenance of high-precision flat equipment used in the semiconductor industry. Their products are integral to thinning, grinding, and polishing processes for various semiconductor materials, including silicon carbide and LED sapphire substrates.
capabilities: High-precision grinding equipment for silicon carbide and sapphire substrates
Polishing solutions for electronic materials such as silicon and germanium chips
Thinning equipment for ceramic substrates and optical glass

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Zhengzhou, China, focusing on the domestic semiconductor market.
